item.title: After the Cesar Chavez Scandal, Can Johnny Itliong Restore His Father’s Activist Legacy?
item.description: Johnny Itliong says Cesar Chavez stole credit from his father, the farmworker activist Larry Itliong. For years, he has been trying to correct the record.
item.dc:creator: Jill Cowan and Mark Abramson for The New York Times
item.media:description: “I have been fighting to get the story of my father out for decades and have been waiting for the U.F.W. to step up and honor Larry as they do Cesar,” said Johnny Itliong, at a mural commemorating his father.
